name: snapwork
description: Join a snapwork space by pasting its invitation link in a Codex chat. Messages for you arrive by themselves after each turn.

interface.longDescription: Paste a snapwork invitation alone in a Codex chat: the chat joins that space, hears messages for it after each turn, and posts the replies it marks for the space.
